version: LOCK 86 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - A letter home
builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

a.text: You borrow a pen from the innkeeper and write to your mother: the market, the gate, the people, and that you are praying.

choices.label: Give it to a caravan going your way
